items.title: Brown Forman (BF.B) Stock May Be 34% Undervalued On CEO Retirement
items.summary: Brown-Forman stock has been under pressure over the past three years, yet its current checks suggest the market may be pricing it below what its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value implies, while earnings based multiples look closer to fair. The share price has fallen about 60.4% over three years, which puts recent valuation signals under a much brighter spotlight for long term investors. items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Approach with Caution
items.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. On the other hand, they usually underperform during bull runs, and this paradigm has rung true over the past six months as the sector’s -3.9% decline paled in comparison to the S&P 500’s 8.4% gain.
